root_cause: Powerhouse had a Composio runtime publisher but no canonical bootstrap path to inspect Instagram auth configs, create managed auth, generate a Connect Link, or validate exactly one active connected account.
prevention: Use the server-side Composio v3.1 setup controller for status and Connect Link creation.
Keep COMPOSIO_API_KEY only in canonical secret storage and never return or log it.
Fail closed on multiple active Instagram accounts or multiple managed auth configs.
Use hosted Connect Links so Instagram OAuth credentials never pass through Powerhouse.
